read.en: Applied Materials rose 0.4% on Oct 23 to $377.24, trading between $372.80 and $384.33. It is below the falling 5-day ($396.0), 10-day ($422.8), 30-day ($463.7) and 100-day ($513.6) averages and the rising 200-day ($441.9). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13 and below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($454.22), and RSI is 26.
read.zh: 应用材料 10月23日上涨 0.4%，收于 $377.24，盘中区间 $372.80–384.33。股价位于下行的 5 日（$396.0）、10 日（$422.8）、30 日（$463.7）和 100 日均线（$513.6）以及上行的 200 日均线（$441.9）下方。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线及零轴下方；抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$454.22），RSI 为 26。

read.en: The $372.8 low undercut Wednesday's low, but the close returned to the $377–380 April-low zone. Resistance is $377–384 (April lows, Oct 23 high), then $396–402 (5-day, May 19 low) and $407–414. Support is $372.8 (Oct 23 low), then $350 and $320.7 (Mar 30 low). A close above $384.3 would target $396–402; a close below $372.8 would open $350.
